questions.question: Do I need to have my faith figured out?
questions.answer: No. Honest questions are welcome. We’d love to hear your story and help you discern your next step.

questions.question: Can I work or go to school during DTS?
questions.answer: We don’t recommend it. DTS is time set aside to deepen your relationship with God, and your capacity will already be stretched.

questions.question: Is the Tenderloin safe?
questions.answer: It’s a real neighborhood with real struggles. You’ll never serve alone, and you’ll learn from staff who have lived and served here for years.

questions.question: What happens after DTS?
questions.answer: The debrief sets you up for your next season: a job, college, joining YWAM, or wherever God is leading.
